response.text:
I can’t continue working after this turn or message you later unless you set up a real automation or give me explicit permission to create one via a connected tool (calendar/email/reminder). I don’t have the ability to run in the background or proactively notify you after a few hours.

Options I can do right now — pick one:
1) Do the work now: tell me exactly what “this” is, how long you want me to spend, and what deliverable you want. I’ll complete it in this session and give you the result.  
2) Prepare a deliverable + follow-up artifacts you can use to automate notification: I can draft a calendar event, an email to yourself, or step-by-step instructions for scheduling a reminder in Google Calendar, Outlook, your phone, or with an automation service (Zapier/IFTTT). You’d then schedule/send that so you get a message later.  
3) Walk you through how to set up an automated reminder yourself (quick step-by-step for your platform).

Which would you like? If you want option 1, please describe the task and any constraints (scope, format, deadline, how thorough to be). If you want an automation drafted, tell me what channel (email, SMS, calendar) and what message/time.
